turn.user_message: How does it know which beds will free up?
turn.context: From bed-management.md §7.4.1 (a) and (b): beds likely to free from patients near the usual stay for their procedure, and §7.4.2 (the 24-hour and 1 PM signals, the 5 PM confirmation).

transcript.label: After transcript turn 31 · Automations, turn 4 (the record stops at 31)

text: It reads the stay so far for each patient. Then it sets it against similar past patients.
bullets: Patients near the usual stay for their procedure are flagged. Nobody has to say it out loud first.
Before the round, the doctor gets a short summary for each patient. It holds a predicted date.
The doctor confirms or corrects it by 5 PM. The engine only predicts. The doctor decides.
chat.invite: Tell me which procedures fill most of your beds. That sets how fine the prediction can be.

blocks.caption: The engine predicts. The doctor decides. Every predicted date goes to a doctor to confirm or correct.
never: It never calls a patient in on a date nobody confirmed.

sheets.title: Spots patients near their usual stay
sheets.text: Each procedure has a usual stay in your own past records. Patients close to it are flagged, ward and ICU alike.
sheets.entry: Which procedures fill most of your beds?

sheets.title: Gathers notes and the stay so far
sheets.text: The engine pulls together the notes, tests and days so far. The doctor does not have to look them up.
sheets.entry: What does a doctor check before saying a patient can go?

sheets.title: Checks against similar past patients
sheets.text: The stay is set against past patients with the same procedure. The engine sets a likely date and how sure it is.
sheets.entry: How many years of past admissions are on your system?

sheets.title: Hands the doctor a summary to confirm
sheets.text: Ward patients need a signal a day ahead. ICU patients need theirs by 1 PM. The summary makes that a quick yes or no.
sheets.entry: Do your doctors give a likely discharge date today?

hand.does: Confirms or corrects the date, by voice or a tap.

sheets.title: Takes the answer into tomorrow’s map
sheets.text: Every answer goes into tomorrow’s bed map. A corrected date moves the bed, and the call-in time with it.
sheets.entry: Who should hear when a date is corrected?

blocks.label: Signal needed
blocks.sub: Ward patients need a discharge signal 24 hours ahead. ICU patients need theirs by 1 PM.
